**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The document's only MFN provision is § 7.6 (p0031), which runs in our favour — Brightline warrants that Fees charged to Northwind will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers for comparable volumes and terms. Targeted searches across Fees/invoicing (§ 7), Order Forms (§ 4), General (§ 30) and the full document for best-pricing, price-matching, "no less favourable", exclusivity, or right-of-first-refusal language surfaced no obligation running against us. Accordingly, we bear no MFN obligation benefiting the Vendor, and no redline was proposed since the existing clause benefits our party.
